package.name: rosidl_typesupport_tickle_c_tests
package.description: A minimal real ROS 2 interface package that exists purely to prove, in CI, that a message generated by rosidl_typesupport_tickle_c is actually reachable through the standard get_message_typesupport_handle() dispatch chain a real rmw_create_publisher() call would use - not just that the generator's own output compiles (rmw_tickle/PLAN.md's Milestone 1(b)/(c)). Not meant to ship or be depended on by anything else.
